searchResponse.query: why does touching the changer reduce hum

results.excerpt: Touching the changer can change the ground reference, so check the cable, jack, pickup ground, volume pedal, and amp input before replacing parts.

answerResponse.answer: The retrieved forum sources point to a grounding or signal-chain issue. Start by bypassing the volume pedal, trying a known-good cable, and checking whether the hum changes when you touch the strings, changer, jack plate, and amp chassis. [1]
